title: 국민연금만으로 충분할까 — 개혁 9.5%·추납·반납·임의가입·연금세금
core_message: NPS reform 2026 premium rate 9.5% escalating to 13% by2033 and state duty to sustain benefits; actuarial payouts do not guarantee fixed future individual amounts. 노령연금 requires >=10 years, 1969+ standard age65, CPI adjustment and survivor pension tiers. Postponed contributions and repayment of prior lump sums differ; voluntary membership for nonworking spouse (about96,230 monthly in 2026 Apr) can fill eligible years. Private annuity 1500 cutoff and option to separate tax are nuanced.
